push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.8 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.8. You played with your head up and your heart out. Love to see it.

THE GOOD
+ 26 passes, your busiest match yet. The ball kept finding you, and that's no coincidence.
+ Won 4 of 8 tackles (up from your usual 26%). Clean as a whistle and twice as loud.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.

THE BAD
- In our wins you average 4 shots; here it was 0. Here's how: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 4 (best was PhogsToffees's 1). That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50% (13 of 26). That has to be the floor, and we never visit the floor again. Try it this way: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Session plan: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

tuxedo_slide, take this with you: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Go put your feet up. - Coach Lasso

tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 2 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 4 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

push.body:
Your 6th worst match performance, BellyTb1, at 7.2. Let's learn and move on.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Shots on target 4, up from your usual 1. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ Passes attempted 17, from 1 in your previous match. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ Drew 2-2 with unbeatables FC. A point is better than none.

THE BAD
- 59% passing (10 of 17, down from your usual 81%). Tiny tweak: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Here's the fix: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 0 goals from 4 on target. Coach's tip: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Your 6th worst match performance at 7.2. Chin up.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was tuxedo_slide's 3). Golden rule: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

Warm-up idea: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Keep chipping away. - Coach Lasso
